_axis: narration tone — contrast (old way vs new way)
_what_we_learn: Does the before/after framing help or add unnecessary length?

beats.line: Traditionally, identity was tied to the human making a request. Agents break that model.
An agent process needs its own identity — one it holds independently of any user. The platform provides a workload certificate authority for exactly this.
At process startup, the CA issues a short-lived credential. This happens before any request, from any user, arrives.
That credential now follows the agent into every outbound call it makes.
The agent's identity and the caller's identity are separate things, tracked separately, audited separately.
